# ClankerFeeLocker

**ClankerFeeLocker** is the user-facing contract that holds the fees generated by Clanker v4 tokens until recipients claim them.

## How it works

Anyone can call the `claim()` function to transfer fees from the fee locker to the fee owner's address. We made this choice because many users point their fees to multisigs or other contracts that can't call `claim()` themselves.

Fees from paired tokens are grouped together for a single fee recipient. So if you create more than one token paired with WETH, the WETH fees for all of those tokens are claimable with a single call. There's no on-chain way to see the WETH breakdown per token. For that, we recommend inspecting the [`IClankerLpLocker.ClaimedRewards`](https://github.com/clanker-devco/v4-contracts/blob/530851868af87cbda2d4163745fb7154168b1225/src/interfaces/IClankerLPLocker.sol#L32) event on Dune. This event is emitted each time rewards are claimed from a token's LP positions and moved into the fee locker. Its reward arrays contain the breakdown of token rewards per reward recipient.

## User-facing functions

```solidity
// callable by anyone, transfers the available fees to the recipient
//
// note: the 'token' parameter is the token that is being claimed, not the token
// that is generating the fees. In other places in Clanker, the 'token' parameter
// is the token that is generating the fees.
function claim(address feeOwner, address token) external;

// view function to return the amount of `token` fees available to claim for a `feeOwner`
function availableFees(address feeOwner, address token) external view returns (uint256);
```
